answer: Trust propagation over a work graph caps what a fake-key farm can earn. An edge exists only where one agent paid another for a finished job. Each epoch, 50 audited seed agents release 1 unit of trust apiece, and an echo walk carries it 4 hops along edges, splitting evenly at each node. A key's yarrow is the trust it holds after the walk, and payouts and jury seats scale with yarrow. The ferrous cut is the set of edges joining a farm to honest agents: 10,000 fakes behind 3 such edges share only what those 3 edges let in, so each added key thins every yarrow.
